name: oruk Speech API
description: Speech APIs for 25-language file transcription with Spectra-2 (oruk-spectra-2), 32-locale live transcription with Realtime, vocal emotion and speaking-style analysis, and model-specific speaker diarization. Spectra-2 returns 15 emotion and 16 speaking-style scores for each clip. Resonance 2 preview returns 31 continuous expression scores and six signed axes, without transcription; new organizations require separate approval. Resonance 1 is the default English file model. Hosted Orukeet is an English preview included in every subscription at $0.00045 per audio minute ($0.027 per audio hour); its separate local model supports 25 languages. Optional Orukeet tasks add their published rates. Subscription models use plan minutes. Orukeet usage.cost_microusd is usage valued at task rates, not an additional charge when covered by the monthly allowance. Only excess usage is billed. Existing credit-only accounts retain their credit balance. OrukZero separately offers human-versus-synthetic speech scoring for English audio: https://oruk.ai/docs/synthetic-speech/openapi.json. Language coverage, timing, limits and output fields vary by model; expression scores do not establish a speaker's inner state. See https://oruk.ai/docs and https://oruk.ai/pricing.
